subject: [PATCH v4 06/11] mm, swap: write back vswap zswap entries to physical swap

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch adds support for writing back zswap-backed vswap entries to physical swap. It mirrors the existing zswap writeback path, but allocates physical backing on demand at writeback time instead of pre-allocating it. The zswap shrinker no longer skips vswap entries unless there is not enough physical swap space available. This allows for more efficient use of swap space and improves system performance.
